topic.name: Berberine
topic.short_description: Natural alkaloid with anti-cancer properties studied in multiple cancer types
topic.seo_title: Berberine Cancer Research - Latest Studies & Findings | Your Cancer Breakthroughs
topic.seo_description: Explore berberine's anti-cancer potential across multiple cancer types. Read latest peer-reviewed research on this natural alkaloid supplement and its mechanisms.
topic.seo_intro:
Berberine is a natural alkaloid compound found in plants such as barberry, goldenseal, and Oregon grape that has gained significant attention in cancer research communities. This yellow-colored plant extract has been used traditionally in Chinese and Ayurvedic medicine for centuries, but modern scientific investigation has begun to uncover potential mechanisms through which berberine may interact with cancer cells at the molecular level.

Researchers have identified several promising pathways through which berberine may exert anti-cancer effects across multiple cancer types, including effects on cell proliferation, apoptosis (programmed cell death), and angiogenesis (new blood vessel formation). Pre-clinical studies in laboratory and animal models have shown encouraging results, leading to increased interest in understanding whether these effects could translate to human cancer treatment. However, it's important to note that most current evidence comes from laboratory studies, with human clinical trials still in early stages for many cancer applications.

This page compiles the latest peer-reviewed research on berberine and cancer, providing you with evidence-based information about what scientists are discovering. Whether you're a patient, caregiver, or healthcare provider seeking to understand berberine's potential role in cancer research, you'll find comprehensive scientific findings below. Please consult with your oncology team before considering any supplements, as berberine may interact with cancer treatments or medications.

articles.title: Targeting the PI3K/Akt/mTOR and Nrf2 signaling axis with berberine: a novel strategy for attenuating diabetic cardiomyopathy.
articles.hook: Berberine reduces inflammation and oxidative stress in diabetic cardiomyopathy
articles.summary: Berberine combined with insulin effectively treats diabetic heart disease by reducing inflammation, oxidative stress, and improving heart function through specific cellular pathways.

articles.title: A small molecule disrupts G4-STAT1 interaction and synergizes with olaparib to drive cancer cell death.
articles.hook: Berberine and coptisine enhance olaparib effectiveness in colorectal cancer cells
articles.summary: Berberine and coptisine block a cancer protein's growth signals and enhance DNA-damaging therapy in colon cancer cells.

articles.title: Berberine alleviates radiation-induced intestinal injury by inhibiting cellular senescence.
articles.hook: Berberine prevents radiation-induced intestinal damage by blocking cellular senescence
articles.summary: Berberine reduces intestinal damage from radiation therapy by preventing cells from aging prematurely.

articles.title: Identification of the target ANTXR1 and covalent acylation mechanism of 8-esterified cycloberberines against cancer.
articles.hook: Cycloberberine derivative 8a targets ANTXR1 protein in cancer cells
articles.summary: Researchers developed compound 8a, a cycloberberine derivative that covalently targets ANTXR1 protein, effectively inhibiting tumor cell growth across multiple cancer types.

articles.title: Berberine and its structural diversity: structure-activity relationships, molecular mechanisms, and drug discovery opportunities.
articles.hook: Structural modifications of berberine enhance anticancer efficacy and bioavailability
articles.summary: Berberine, a natural compound, shows promise against cancer and other diseases, but researchers are redesigning its structure to improve effectiveness and drugability.

articles.title: Emerging roles of combined curcumin and berberine in disease modulation: a comprehensive review of mechanisms and therapeutic relevance.
articles.hook: Curcumin and berberine combination induces cancer cell death via inflammatory pathways
articles.summary: Curcumin and berberine combined show promise against cancer and multiple diseases by triggering cell death and reducing inflammation through multiple cellular pathways.

articles.title: Berberine Improved the Therapeutic Efficacy of UC-MSCs for DSS-Induced Colitis via Aerobic Glycolysis.
articles.hook: Berberine enhances mesenchymal stem cell therapy for inflammatory colitis
articles.summary: Berberine enhances stem cell treatment for colitis by boosting their energy metabolism and immune-balancing properties.

articles.title: The anti-ulcerative potential of Berberine on the rat model of inflammatory bowel disease.
articles.summary: Berberine reduces inflammation and tissue damage in rats with ulcerative colitis by suppressing inflammatory markers and activating protective cellular pathways.

articles.title: Berberine enhances cisplatin efficacy in ehrlich ascites carcinoma via modulation of apoptotic pathway and efferocytosis.
articles.summary: Berberine enhances cisplatin's cancer-fighting ability in Ehrlich ascites carcinoma while reducing drug toxicity to the liver and kidneys.

articles.title: Tetrahydroberberine Targets the bcl-2 Promoter G-Quadruplex to Trigger Mitochondrial Apoptosis and Inhibit Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma Progression.
articles.summary: Tetrahydroberberine kills nasopharyngeal cancer cells by binding a DNA structure that silences an anti-death gene, triggering programmed cell death.
